en_title: GTA 6 Reportedly Set for PC Q1 2027
subtitle: 或只需再等数月
opus_summary: 据四名匿名消息人士透露，《GTA6》PC版计划于2027年第一季度推出，可能与多人模式的推出有关。若属实，PC版将比主机版晚数月，官方尚未回应。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar reportedly plans to release GTA 6 on PC during the first quarter of 2027.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，Rockstar计划在2027年第一季度推出《GTA6》PC版。

paragraphs.en: GamesBeat reported the news based on four sources who asked to remain anonymous. Rockstar and parent company Take-Two are yet to comment.
paragraphs.cn: GamesBeat援引四名要求匿名的消息人士报道了这一消息。Rockstar及其母公司Take-Two尚未回应。

paragraphs.en: If true, it would mean GTA 6 hitting PC just a few months after it launches on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S on November 19, 2026. Some had anticipated a longer wait for the game on PC, given it took nearly two years for GTA 5 to launch on PC after consoles.
paragraphs.cn: 如果消息属实，《GTA6》在2026年11月19日登陆PS5和XBOX Series后，只需再过几个月就会推出PC版。此前有人预计，PC玩家需要等待更久，毕竟《GTA5》在主机版发售近两年后才登陆PC。

paragraphs.en: The PC launch may tie into the release of GTA 6's multiplayer mode, which fans are calling GTA Online 2 while they wait for official word from Rockstar. While Rockstar has yet to confirm an online mode for GTA 6, last month Twitch boss Dan Clancy said GTA Online 2 — or whatever GTA 6’s multiplayer mode is called — will launch next year.
paragraphs.cn: PC版的推出可能与《GTA6》多人模式的上线有关。在等待Rockstar官方消息期间，粉丝们暂且将这个模式称为《GTA Online 2》。虽然Rockstar尚未确认《GTA6》会有在线模式，但Twitch负责人Dan Clancy上个月表示，《GTA Online 2》——不管《GTA6》的多人模式最终叫什么——将于明年上线。
